title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
abstract: arXiv:2609.36726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. translated_title: AI科学家能改变想法吗？合成宇宙中的先验-证据冲突
translated_abstract: 一个科学智能体能否区分它是从证据中推断出的定律，还是它仅仅识别出的定律？我们提出了"合成宇宙"(Synthetic Universes)，这是一个受控基准，将经典的著名世界与配对的"扭曲孪生世界"相匹配，后者由相近的非经典机制所支配。我们对每条报告的定律进行两次评估：通过在留出的延续和迁移设置上执行该定律进行两次评估：以及独立检验它是否能恢复生成机制。在一个预先指定的60单元研究的当前检查点中，已对22个试验进行了评分，另有一次运行因基础设施故障而终止。在20个孪生试验中，8个通过了预测验证，而5个恢复了生成器。这种分离是双向的：六个可解析的输出成功预测但遗漏了机制，而三个恢复了机制却在预测展开中失败。阻力表现出第一种模式（5/5预测通过，1/5机制恢复）；引力表现出第二种模式（1/5预测通过
tldr: 该论文提出"合成宇宙"受控基准，通过配对经典世界与机制相近的扭曲孪生世界，揭示AI科学智能体在预测成功与恢复真实生成机制之间存在双向分离——能预测未必理解机制，能恢复机制未必能准确预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark pairing canonical worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms, revealing a bidirectional dissociation between predictive success and mechanism recovery in AI scientific agents—agents that predict well may not recover the true generator, and those that recover it may still fail at prediction.
